fields.description: Issue includes editorials and political commentary on Florida’s 1928 campaigns (including the governor’s race and local offices), discussion of East vs. West Florida interests, and numerous candidate notices/ads. Reports and commentary touch on Prohibition enforcement and contraband liquor at the county stockade, road conditions on the Tamiami Trail and other Florida routes, local civic/commerce matters (including convention-related concessions), and community entertainment listings and advertisements for Miami and Miami Beach.
